cells.title: Check owner briefs at the add door and list the owner view
cells.action: Implement D1-D10 of docs/history/owner-brief/CONTEXT.md. Steps in order. 1. RED FIRST. Write the tests below, run them, and watch them fail before the code exists. 2. New module packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/brief.rs, registered as `pub mod brief;` in verbs/mod.rs beside `pub mod backlog;`. It holds: (a) `pub(crate) fn brief_rel(id: &str) -> String` returning `docs/briefs/.md`. (b) `pub(crate) fn brief_language(root: &Path) -> (String, Option)` reading `brief.language` through `crate::state::read_config_raw`: absent -> ("vi", None); "vi" or "en" -> that; any other string -> ("vi", Some()) (per D3). (c) `pub(crate) fn validate_brief(text: &str, language: &str) -> Vec` returning every defect as a plain sentence, empty when valid. Normalize CRLF to LF. Rules (per D1, D2, D3): the text starts with a `---` line and a second `---` line closes the frontmatter; each non-empty frontmatter line is `key: value` with no leading whitespace (no nesting); keys title, audience, size, ask are required; title is non-empty and at most 80 characters (count chars, not bytes); audience in {owner, internal}; size in {S, M, L}; ask in {build, park, drop, answer, test}; other keys are allowed. Body = everything after the closing `---`. The six labels for vi are exactly `**Là gì:**`, `**Vì sao:**`, `**Nguồn gốc:**`, `**Chi phí và rủi ro:**`, `**Anh cần làm:**`, `**Chuẩn xong:**`; for en `**What:**`, `**Why:**`, `**Origin:**`, `**Cost and risk:**`, `**Your call:**`, `**Done when:**`. The first non-blank body line starts with the first label; each label starts exactly one line, the six appear in that order, and no other line starts with `**`; each label's section (its line after the label plus the lines up to the next label) holds non-blank text; the last section holds 2 to 4 lines starting with `- `. Word count = whitespace-separated body tokens containing at least one alphanumeric char (labels included, bare `-` excluded); it must be 120 to 220 inclusive, and the defect names the count. Forbidden in the body (each named with the token found): a token matching `p-` followed by 8 lowercase hex chars; a token (stripped of surrounding punctuation `()[]{},.;:!?"'`) containing `/`; a token ending in .rs .md .json .js .mjs .ts .py .sh .toml .yml .yaml; any backtick char; any `identifier(` call shape (an ASCII letter or underscore run immediately followed by `(`). (d) `pub(crate) enum BriefStatus { Ok, Missing, Malformed(Vec) }` and `pub(crate) fn brief_status(root: &Path, id: &str) -> BriefStatus`. (e) `pub(crate) fn owner_view(root: &Path) -> Value`: active features = the `feature` of `.bee/state.json` plus each `.bee/lanes/*.json` record's `feature`, keeping those whose `phase` is not `idle` and not `compounding-complete` (per D6), de-duplicated, sorted; PBIs from `super::backlog::fold_pbi_records(root)`; live = status proposed or in-flight (per D5); an in-flight PBI whose `feature` is an active feature is folded into that feature (per D7); every other live PBI is its own item. Output `{"language": , "unknown_language": , "items": [{"kind": "feature"|"pbi", "id", "title" (PBI title; a feature uses its brief frontmatter title when the brief parses, else its slug), "status" (feature phase or PBI status), "brief": {"status": "ok"|"missing"|"malformed", "path", "defects": [..]}, "folded": [{"id", "title"}] (features only)}], "problems": }`, features first, then PBIs in fold order. 3. packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/backlog.rs (per D4, D8): add `brief-file` to the parse_shape lists of `pbi add` (`parse_shape(rest, &["title", "cos", "status", "feature", "id"])?`) and `propose` (`run_propose(parse_shape(&args[2..], &["story", "cos", "feature"])?, t0)`). In run_pbi_add and run_propose, after the preamble and BEFORE add_pbi: when --brief-file is given, read it (relative to the process cwd; unreadable -> emit_error naming the path, nothing written) and validate it with brief_language; any defect -> emit_error whose message starts `backlog pbi add: the owner brief is malformed — nothing was added:` (or `backlog propose: ...`) followed by every defect, and nothing written. After a successful add with a brief: create `docs/briefs/` under ctx.root and write the file's bytes unchanged to `docs/briefs/.md`. The success value gains `"brief": "ok"|"missing"` and `"brief_path": "docs/briefs/.md"` ("ok" also when no flag was given but a valid file already sits there); when missing, the text output gains a second line `warning: no owner brief — write docs/briefs/.md and check it with: bee backlog briefs --id `. Add verb `briefs` to try_native: `"briefs" => run_briefs(parse_shape(&args[2..], &["id"])?, t0)`. With --id: report that one brief (`ok docs/briefs/.md`, or `MISSING`/`MALFORMED` plus one indented defect per line); exit 1 when not ok. Without --id: print owner_view, one line per item ` — `, defects indented below, folded PBIs indented as ` folded <id> — <title>`, then a summary line `<n> item(s), <p> without a valid owner brief`; exit 1 when problems > 0, else 0. --json prints the same value (with the usual envelope the other backlog verbs use) and keeps the exit code rule. Do not change run_render or docs/backlog.md (per D10). 4. packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/router.rs: add `"backlog briefs",` to the native list after `"backlog pbi list",`. packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/generated/registry_payload.json: add the `brief-file` string parameter to `backlog.pbi.add` and `backlog.propose` (description: path of an owner brief draft; validated against docs/briefs contract and copied to docs/briefs/<id>.md; malformed refuses the add; absent adds and warns), and a new `backlog.briefs` entry (invoke `bee backlog briefs`, parameters id and json, a description stating D5-D8 in plain words) whose examples[0] satisfies tests/registry_dispatch.rs's contract — read that test first; pick an example that exits the way the test expects in its fixture repo. 5. packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/doctor.rs (per D9): add `fn owner_briefs_advisory(root: &Path) -> Option<(Value, String)>` beside `team_config_advisory`, calling `crate::verbs::brief::owner_view`; None when problems == 0; else a row `{"row": "owner_briefs", "status": "note", "detail": ...}` and the detail `<p> live item(s) or active feature(s) have no valid owner brief — run: bee backlog briefs`. In doctor_report push it after the team advisory and add a ` note owner_briefs ...` line in the same style; overall_status must not change. 6. Tests (no comments anywhere): in brief.rs `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`: the vi draft at docs/history/owner-brief/brief-draft.md (copy its text into a const) validates clean; each defect class refuses by name (missing frontmatter, nested key, title of 81 chars, bad audience, bad size, bad ask, missing label, labels out of order, 119 words, 221 words, a 5-bullet last section, a p-1234abcd token, a path token, a .rs token, a backtick, a `foo(` call); an en brief validates under en and fails under vi; brief_language reads absent/vi/en/unknown; owner_view folds an in-flight PBI under an active lane feature, keeps a proposed PBI with the same feature as its own item, skips parked/done/declined and idle or compounding-complete features. In backlog.rs's tests module: pbi add with a valid --brief-file writes docs/briefs/<id>.md byte-identical and returns brief ok; with a malformed one refuses and leaves .bee/backlog.jsonl and docs/briefs untouched; without the flag adds and returns brief missing with the warning line; propose takes --brief-file the same way; briefs --id exit codes for ok/missing/malformed; briefs listing exit 1 with a missing brief and 0 when all ok. In doctor/tests.rs: the owner_briefs note appears with a missing brief and overall_status is unchanged. Follow each tests module's existing temp-repo helpers. 7. Run the verify command; all green. NO CODE COMMENTS of any form in what you add. One commit, imperative subject, trailer `cell: ob-1`.

truths: bee backlog pbi add --brief-file with a valid brief stores it byte-identical at docs/briefs/<id>.md and reports brief ok
a malformed brief refuses the add naming every defect, and no PBI event and no brief file is written
pbi add and propose with no brief still add the item, report brief missing and print the warning line naming docs/briefs/<id>.md
bee backlog briefs lists active features with their in-flight PBIs folded inside, lists unfolded proposed and in-flight PBIs, names each missing or malformed brief, and exits 1 when any exists
bee backlog briefs --id checks one brief and exits 1 when it is missing or malformed
the validator enforces the D1 frontmatter, the D3 label set for the configured language, 120-220 words and the D2 forbidden tokens
bee doctor shows an owner_briefs note without changing overall_status
docs/backlog.md rendering is unchanged

artifacts.substantive: brief_rel, brief_language, validate_brief, BriefStatus, brief_status, owner_view and their unit tests
--brief-file on pbi add and propose, run_briefs, and their tests
owner_briefs_advisory wired into doctor_report as a note
brief-file parameters and the backlog.briefs entry

key_links: run_pbi_add and run_propose call validate_brief before add_pbi
doctor_report calls owner_briefs_advisory which calls owner_view

No change to the PBI event shape in .bee/backlog.jsonl
No code comment of any form
No edit outside the listed files

cells.action:
Write every sentence through the bee-technical-writing skill. Per D1-D12 of docs/history/owner-brief/CONTEXT.md.

1. New knowledge concept docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/owner-brief-contract.md, in the frontmatter and section shape of backlog-store.md beside it. Include one GOOD example: the full text of docs/history/owner-brief/brief-draft.md in a fenced block. Include one BAD example: the one-line CoS `A comment by a person on a mirrored task reaches the mapped project's leader as a dispatch; deferred from wd-mirror shaping`, followed by why it fails (no why, no cost, no reason for the deferral, no ask, an internal slug the owner cannot read). Pointers section names packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/brief.rs, verbs/backlog.rs and doctor.rs. Add its index line to docs/knowledge/areas/decision-memory/index.md in the existing list style, and one sentence plus link in backlog-store.md where the PBI add door is described.

2. skills/bee-shaping/SKILL.md: in `## Lock (single writer)`, add a short paragraph: Lock also writes `docs/briefs/<feature>.md`, the owner brief, drawn from the Feature Boundary and the Locked Decisions in the owner language, and checks it with `bee backlog briefs --id <feature>`; the contract lives in the concept (link it by repo-relative path). Run `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write) so every rendered skill copy and docs/history/codex-harness-hardening/release-manifest.json match (never hand-edit a rendered copy); commit the regen output with the rest.
